description: Reviewed exemptions of the Phase 5 debt measures (SWLOR.Architecture.Tests, Phase5DebtTests). exemptions: what the size and services measures skip, by the categories of owner decision 1 (2026-11-14): generated code, migrations, attribute-row enums, content data definitions (data only: a definition with real logic is not exempt), data catalog members and fluent builders made of short methods. match is folder (a path prefix from the repository root, ending in /), file, type (a full type name), member (a full type name, a dot and the member name) or generatedHeader (text in a file's header, before its first declaration). measures: typeSize (LargeTypes.txt; an exempt member's lines are taken out of its type), methodSize (LongMethods.txt), servicesPerType (ServicesPerType.txt). Nothing exempts from the static lookup, deferred resolution, content reference, cycle or static state measures. approvedStaticEntryPoints: the static entry points owner decision 3 keeps static (not listed in StaticState.txt). The guard fails when an entry names nothing in the server. Add an entry only with the owner's approval.
